meta.name: cull-release
meta.description: Use when orchestrating or resuming Cull's complete release cycle, reporting its current release state, or fulfilling an explicit Cull patch, minor, or major release request through verified GitHub and Homebrew distribution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动编排并执行完整的软件发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责该项目的版本发布工作，需要自动化发布周期。
copy.tagline_en: Automate the full release cycle of your software.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage the release process of this project.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照 Cull 项目的发布流程执行：解析仓库位置，使用子技能检查阻塞、在隔离工作树准备、发布到 GitHub 和 Homebrew，验证结果，并报告版本、提交、标签等。
howto.when: 当用户要求执行 Cull 的完整发布流程、汇报当前发布状态，或明确请求补丁、小版本或大版本发布时触发。

say.text: 帮我发布Cull的一个补丁版本。

say.note: 会从上次验证的阶段继续。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude orchestrates Cull's release cycle: resolves the repo, checks blockers, prepares in an isolated worktree, publishes to GitHub and Homebrew, verifies, and reports version, commit, tag, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to start or resume Cull's complete release cycle, report its current release state, or explicitly request a patch, minor, or major release.

say_en.text: Publish a patch release for Cull.

say_en.note: Continues from the last verified phase.
